brethren-of-jesus.name: The brethren of Jesus
brethren-of-jesus.note: His kinsmen, who do not believe in him; urging, half taunting.

jesus.name: Jesus
jesus.note: The Lord; teaching with authority, calm and grave.

the-jews.name: The Jews
the-jews.note: The Jewish authorities and opponents in Jerusalem and Capharnaum; challenging, hostile.

some-people.name: Some of the multitude
some-people.note: Those in the crowd who speak well of Jesus.

other-people.name: Others of the multitude
other-people.note: Others in the crowd, answering the first group.

crowd.name: The multitude
crowd.note: The people who follow Jesus; eager, curious, at times indignant.

men-of-jerusalem.name: Some of Jerusalem
men-of-jerusalem.note: Townsmen of Jerusalem, puzzled that he speaks openly.

objectors.name: Objectors in the multitude
objectors.note: Those who object that the Christ cannot come from Galilee; sceptical.

pharisees.name: The Pharisees
pharisees.note: Pharisees of the council; scornful, accusing.

ministers.name: The ministers
ministers.note: Temple officers sent to arrest Jesus; awed.

nicodemus.name: Nicodemus
nicodemus.note: A ruler of the Jews, one of the Pharisees; cautious, fair-minded.

1.t: After these things, Jesus walked in Galilee: for he would not walk in Judea, because the Jews sought to kill him.

2.t: Now the Jews feast of tabernacles was at hand.

3.t: And his brethren said to, him:
Pass from hence and go into Judea, that thy disciples also may see thy works which thou dost.

4.t: For there is no man that doth any thing in secret, and he himself seeketh to be known openly. If thou do these things, manifest thyself to the world.

5.t: For neither did his brethren believe in him.

6.t: My time is not yet come; but your time is always ready.

7.t: The world cannot hate you: but me it hateth, because I give testimony of it, that the works thereof are evil,

8.t: Go you up to this festival day: but I go not up to this festival day, because my time is not accomplished.

9.t: When he had said these things, he himself stayed in Galilee.

10.t: But after his brethren were gone up, then he also went up to the feast, not openly, but, as it were, in secret.

11.t: The Jews therefore sought him on the festival day and said:

12.t: And there was much murmuring among the multitude concerning him. For some said:
No, but he seduceth the people.

13.t: Yet no man spoke openly of him, for fear of the Jews.

14.t: Now, about the midst of the feast, Jesus went up into the temple and taught.

15.t: How doth this man know letters, having never learned?

16.t: My doctrine is not mine, but his that sent me.

17.t: If any man will do the will of him, he shall know of the doctrine, whether it be of God, or whether I speak of myself.

18.t: He that speaketh of himself seeketh his own glory: but he that seeketh the glory of him that sent him, he is true and there is no injustice in him.

19.t: Did not Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keepeth the law?

20.t: Why seek you to kill me?
Thou hast a devil. Who seeketh to kill thee?

21.t: Jesus answered and said to them:
One work I have done: and you all wonder.

22.t: Therefore, Moses gave you circumcision (not because it is of Moses, but of the fathers): and on the sabbath day you circumcise a man.

23.t: If a man receive circumcision on the sabbath day, that the law of Moses may not be broken: are you angry at me, because I have healed the whole man on the sabbath day?

24.t: Judge not according to the appearance: but judge just judgment.

25.t: Is not this he whom they seek to kill?

26.t: And behold, he speaketh openly: and they say nothing to him. Have the rulers known for a truth that this is the Christ?

27.t: But we know this man, whence he is: but when the Christ cometh, no man knoweth, whence he is.

28.t: Jesus therefore cried out in the temple, teaching and saying:
You both know me, and you know whence I am. And I am not come of myself: but he that sent me is true, whom you know not.

29.t: I know him, because I am from him: and he hath sent me.

30.t: They sought therefore to apprehend him: and no man laid hands on him, because his hour was not yet come.

31.t: But of the people many believed in him and said:
When the Christ cometh, shall he do more miracles than this man doth?

32.t: The Pharisees heard the people murmuring these things concerning him: and the rulers and Pharisees sent ministers to apprehend him.

33.t: Yet a little while I am with you: and then I go to him that sent me.

34.t: You shall seek me and shall not find me: and where I am, thither you cannot come.

35.t: The Jews therefore said among themselves:
Whither will he go, that we shall not find him? Will he go unto the dispersed among the Gentiles and teach the Gentiles?

36.t: What is this saying that he hath said: You shall seek me and shall not find me? And: Where I am, you cannot come?

37.t: And on the last, and great day of the festivity, Jesus stood and cried, saying:
If any man thirst, let him come to me and drink.

38.t: He that believeth in me, as the scripture saith: Out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.

39.t: Now this he said of the Spirit which they should receive who believed in him: for as yet the Spirit was not given, because Jesus was not yet glorified.

40.t: Of that multitude therefore, when they had heard these words of his, some said:

41.t: Doth the Christ come out of Galilee?

42.t: Doth not the scripture say: That Christ cometh of the seed of David and from Bethlehem the town where David was?

43.t: So there arose a dissension among the people because of him.

44.t: And some of them would have apprehended him: but no man laid hands upon him.

45.t: The ministers therefore came to the chief priests and the Pharisees. And they said to them:
Why have you not brought him?
45.q: spoken by the chief priests and the Pharisees together; given to the Pharisees, who carry on the exchange in v. 47

46.t: Never did man speak like this man.

48.t: Hath any one of the rulers believed in him, or of the Pharisees?

49.t: But this multitude, that knoweth not the law, are accursed.

50.t: Nicodemus said to them (he that came to him by night, who was one of them):

51.t: Doth our law judge any man, unless it first hear him and know what he doth?

52.t: They answered and said to him:
Art thou also a Galilean? Search the scriptures, and see that out of Galilee a prophet riseth not.

53.t: And every man returned to his own house.
